w: At 6.50 p.m. Swamishri arrived in the evening assembly. A drama on the disadvantages of television, ‘Sugar Coated Poison’, was performed by the youths of the Bharuch Satsang community.

Swamishri emphasized in his blessings, "We know the harmful effects and damage that television causes, yet we cannot give it up. And so our lives become unstable due to addictions and other evils. One can only be saved from it if one exercises discrimination, otherwise it is impossible! Everyone, the young and old are casually exposed to this poison. However, we fail to realise that this poison penetrates us and eventually destroys us. And so our life becomes useless.

"We fail to do what is important in life. Through Satsang one is blessed with discrimination. Until one attains the qualities of dharma, namely, truth, non-violence, celibacy, devotion... Man is bound by family disciplines, social disciplines, national laws, moral laws and God’s laws. If he abides by these laws then he is a human being."

A celebration of Lord Swaminarayan's 220 birth anniversary according to the English date was held in the presence of Swamishri. Swamishri played the 'kartal' on the beat of the bhajan, "Sonana bor jhule Dharmakishore…" and blessed the assembly.
Swamishri performed pujan of the foundation-bricks for a sanskardham in the suburb of Maninagar, Amdavad.
For the celebration of Shri Hari Jayanti, a grand annakut was arranged before Thakorji. After darshan, Swamishri performed arti of Thakorji.

223rd Shri Hari Jayanti Celebration At 6.00 p.m. Pujya Brahmadarshan Swami discoursed on the motive of Shriji Maharaj's birth on earth. Thereafter Pujya Vivkesagar Swami addressed the assembly. Then sadhus sang "Premvati sut jayo anupam..." Swamishri finally blessed the occasion and spoke about the glory of devotion to Shriji Maharaj. Swamishri performed the celebration arti of Thakorji on stage and then rocked Thakorji in a decorative cradle. As the festive bhajans were being sung, sadhus danced with joy and enthusiasm. Swamishri joined the devotional celebration by playing the kartal and traditionally danced and gestured to the joy of everyone. The celebration concluded on a devotional note.

In the morning assembly Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha pujan and arti rituals of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj for Botad Mandir; Hanumanji and Ganapatiji for Patana Mandir and a small murti of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj to be installed at the main mandir entrance in Sikandrabad.
Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honoured by devotees.

A father had brought his ailing child from Junagadh for Swamishri’s blessings. The boy was suffering from Hodgkin’s disease, a cancer of the lymph nodes, and had innumerable tumours all over his body. An attendant sadhu asked Swamishri for some flowers so that he could give them to him as blessings. But Swamishri said that he would like to pray for the boy and bless him himself. Swamishri came out of his room. The summer heat was oppressive.

Swamishri went to the child, Allaukik Madhav Bhatt, and initiated him into Satsang by giving him a little water in his hand and chanted the vartman mantra. Then Swamishri sprinkled the holy water from his morning puja on the boy’s head and body and chanted the Swaminarayan mantra. Swamishri prayed for the liberation of his soul and sprinkled flower petals on his head. Swamishri consoled the boy’s father, “He has cancer; God will be compassionate upon him. His will shall prevail. I have prayed that he does not suffer further.”
To the child Swamishri said, “You keep remembering God. You have my blessings for no pain.”

Sadhus had come to take a flower for a child. Telling Pramukh Swami Maharaj about it, they said, "A father has brought his son from Junagadh to receive your blessings. He has a cancer called Hodgkin's in his body. Because of it, some three to four thousand lumps, small and large, have broken out all over his body. So he has been told not to come into the room. Please bless him and give him sanctified flowers." Seeing the child's extremely pitiful condition, Swamishri too was deeply moved.
Swamishri said, "Why a flower? Bring him here!"
Because of his illness, the sadhus were hesitant.
Swamishri said, "Then bring him outside the room. Let us sprinkle sanctified water on him so that the poor boy is liberated." This was Swamishri's wish for his liberation.

Within a short while the child was brought out of the room to the veranda facing the garden. He was seated on a chair. Swamishri came out. A strong hot wind was blowing. Going close to this child, Alaukik Madhavbhai Bhatt of Junagadh, Swamishri gave him vartman (initiation) and had him recite the vartman mantra "Kal maya papkarma...". He sprinkled the sanctified water from his puja on his head and his whole body, prayed to Maharaj and had the dhun of the Swaminarayan mahamantra sung. Standing with eyes closed, Swamishri prayed for a moment for his liberation, and also showered him with flowers. Swamishri said to his father, "Such a cancer has come, but God will be compassionate. Whatever His wish is will happen, but the prayer is that he does not suffer any more." Swamishri said to Alaukik, "Keep remembering God. My blessings are that you do not suffer."
This shower of Swamishri's compassion on the suffering child touched everyone's heart.

(For detailed report see Swaminarayan Bliss, May 2010.)

Shri Vijay Karad, founder of the famous MIT technology institute in Maharashtra and UNESCO Chair holder in Human Rights, Democracy, Peace and Tolerance, came today especially for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan and blessings. During the meeting he said (in Hindi), "I am from the Warkari Sampraday. The tradition of the Warkari Sampraday has been running for 100 years and works for world peace, but the greatest work for world peace is yours alone. For the first time you have taken India to such heights and established the prestige of spiritual knowledge. India is a land of knowledge. Such great work has been done through the Swaminarayan Sampraday, and everyone praises it."

ds.t: The inauguration of the water show
w: Today, dignitaries from Gujarat and across India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham, honouring the invitation, to enjoy the inauguration ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show, unique in the world and the first of its kind in India.

To welcome the dignitaries, there was an unbroken line of volunteers from the entrance gate of Akshardham all the way to the water show pavilion. Right opposite the pavilion, in the middle, touching the huge water tank, a small and very beautiful stage had been decorated. Pramukh Swami Maharaj's seat, covered with flowers, looked simple yet very beautiful.

At exactly 6:30, Param Pujya Swamishri and the dignitaries who were to sit on the stage entered. Before that, the dignitaries in the audience had taken their places. Among the many well-known dignitaries in the audience were the Speaker of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt, Finance Minister Shri Vajubhai Vala, Minister Shri Nitinbhai Patel, Minister Shri Saurabhbhai Patel, Vice President of the Bharatiya Janata Party Shri Purushottambhai Rupala and others. The famous scientist and father of the Indian supercomputer Dr Vijay Bhatkar and the Ujjain-based scientist Ghanshyam Pandey were also in the audience. In addition, there were many IAS and IPS officers, chairmen and heads of various corporations, international industrialists, owners and editors of various newspapers, writers, vice chancellors of universities, nationally known doctors in various fields, chartered accountants and advocates, as well as media representatives and leading satsangis, in all about 1,800 dignitaries.

On the stage with Swamishri were Kothari Bhaktipriya Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami. On the other side were the chief guest of today's ceremony, the Chief Minister of Gujarat Shri Narendrabhai Modi, India's famous nuclear scientist and member of the Government of India's technical council Dr R. Chidambaram, and the creative director of this water show, Shri Yves Pépin.
The atmosphere was divine and unforgettable. Everyone's body and mind were experiencing a different kind of vibration.

At exactly 6:30 in the evening, this auspicious programme began with the chanting of Vedic mantras by the children of the BAPS Bal Mandal. By singing the sacred mantras in which, thousands of years ago, the great rishis praised the supreme reality in the Upanishads and the Kathopanishad, and in which the maharshis explained the glory of Brahman and Parabrahman, the children gave the atmosphere a Vedic touch.

After that, the director of the water show, Shri Yves Pépin, addressed the gathering and said, "The very first thing is that I wanted to take part in this project, because this project is completely different from all the shows I have done so far in various countries of the world. I have done many shows, but they were all made only for people's entertainment. This show, however, has a message. This message of Indian culture and deep spirituality has been taken from the Upanishads. It is a message for every person who has spirituality. And that is exactly why I wanted to be part of this project. I must say that all the BAPS volunteers and sadhus who worked with me, including Pramukh Swami Maharaj, have worked with me like a family. I have had the joy of working with a true family. These family feelings with them have made me feel very good. To share in these values, I have given my time to this project with great passion. For me and for the team I worked with, this show is utterly unique compared with any other activity. It is a way of giving a spiritual message, and that way leads everyone towards Akshardham..."

Today, dignitaries from Gujarat and across India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham, honouring the invitation, to enjoy the inauguration ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show, unique in the world and the first of its kind in India.

India's eminent nuclear scientist and former chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission, Dr R. Chidambaram, said, "Pramukh Swami Maharaj has honoured me by inviting me to the inauguration ceremony of the laser water show being held here. I have been meeting Pramukh Swami Maharaj for the last 15 years, and at every meeting I experience some new elevation, an upward rise. This morning too I was fortunate to spend an hour with him. I visited Akshardham many years ago, and I was present at the inauguration of Akshardham in Delhi. I have come here after a very long time. In Delhi you have not only created a spiritual atmosphere, you also have great scientists: the famous scientists of ancient India, Bhaskaracharya, Aryabhatta and Sushruta, and modern scientists C. V. Raman, J. C. Bose and others. In the wonderful boat ride exhibition at Swaminarayan Akshardham in Delhi, one sees our ancient science.

"The laser water show that has been created here is a symbol of a unique blending of technology and spirituality. Science can never accept that which is not manifest, and science can never give an answer to it. These are all subtle and profound ideas. They are not so easy to understand. I am confident that in what we are about to see in the laser show, everyone will find their own interpretation of it."

Today, dignitaries from Gujarat and across India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham, honouring the invitation, to enjoy the inauguration ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show, unique in the world and the first of its kind in India.

Chief Minister Narendrabhai Modi paid a wonderful tribute to the divine personality and work of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Addressing the dignitaries present, he said, "Today, in the world, in Gujarat, in Gandhinagar and at Akshardham, the first water show coloured with spirituality, with a fine blending of spirituality and science, is beginning. I was continuously in touch with this project, and seeing the enthusiasm and zeal with which all the sadhus were engaged in creating it, and the joy of turning a vision into reality that overflowed in their words, I felt that something wonderful was being created here, which has the power to connect the people who come to Akshardham with India's thousands of years old culture.

"I often feel that all the management institutes of the world should make a case study of the work done by Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj. In it they will find the highest principles of management and a glimpse of Indianness. If one wants to learn how human skill can be used in the best and most fruitful way, how resources can be mobilised as quickly as possible, and how resources and human skill can be combined within a fixed time frame, one should make a deep study of the works completed under Pramukh Swami Maharaj's leadership. His works give us a great opportunity to understand the principles of management in Indian life. It is a joy that in India sadhus are working with the most modern management skills, and this has the power to change the world's view of India.

"Information technology has compelled the world to look at India differently. I believe that the works being carried out by Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj, and the form in which they are being carried out, will compel the world to see, think about and accept our great tradition in a new way.

"Experience has proved that the traditions our rishis and munis established and developed, the inspiration they gave for living, and the teachings they gave on conduct and thought, have passed the test of science. There is nothing in our philosophy of life that has not been weighed on the scales of science.

"What a wonderful meeting of East and West there is here! An artist from the West joins the heritage of the East with science and presents it before us. And only Pramukh Swami can do such work. When Mr Yves Pépin first came here, the problem must have started with pronouncing the name Nachiketa itself. Even so, to absorb the character of Nachiketa, then give it a creative form and connect it with technology, I believe all this is the result of wonderful dedication. And our new generation will benefit from it. Wonderful work of teaching easily and playfully through entertainment and science is going to be done from here. Coming to Akshardham, a person's faith will become firmer. Seeing the exhibitions of Akshardham, a person will be able to experience the vast sky of knowledge.
"Whoever comes here will receive strength and inspiration to live in a new way, and I bow wholeheartedly to Pramukh Swami Maharaj for choosing the character of Nachiketa."

Today, dignitaries from Gujarat and across India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham, honouring the invitation, to enjoy the inauguration ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show, unique in the world and the first of its kind in India.

At the end, everyone was very eager to hear the blessings of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the inspirer of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show, through whose constant warmth and inspiration this water show was created. In a simple and calm style, Swamishri blessed everyone and said:

"Yves Pépin's name is so fitting: 'pi' and 'pa' (drink and give to drink). You drink, and in return give others to drink. You have shown the story of Nachiketa very beautifully in the water show. Drink such spiritual talks yourself and give them to others to drink. It is such a fitting name.

"The story of Nachiketa comes in the Kathopanishad. His father, the rishi Uddalak, performed a great yagna and gave thousands of cows in charity to Brahmins. We should give in charity only what is dear to us and good, but the cows Uddalak gave were dry and half dead. Nachiketa felt that it was not right for his father to give such charity. If you give, give good charity. Nachiketa questioned his father, the father became angry and in his rage said, 'Go, I have given you to Yamraj.' Nachiketa was cultured and obedient. Today's times are such that people leave their fathers somewhere in the forest, but Nachiketa went to the court of Yamraj. Yama was pleased with his firmness. Nachiketa asked for boons. How cultured the son is! His father sends him to Yamraj, yet he asks for a boon for his father's peace. What our Indian values are like can be seen in such incidents. Today there are problems in every home, but if we listen to and learn such spiritual talks, there will be peace in the family, in society and in the country. There are many such talks in the Upanishads, but we have no time to read them. Yet those who have read them and reflected on them have walked that path and become happy.

"When Nachiketa asks for the boon of being told the secret of death, Yamraj offers him the pleasures of the world of the gods, but Nachiketa refuses and asks for spiritual knowledge, knowledge of the liberation of the soul. He asked for that which brings peace and happiness and the good of others. Then Yama spoke of 'Uttishthata jagrata prapya varan nibodhata...' (Arise, awake, and learn by approaching the great). Go and take refuge in great persons who enjoy such spiritual bliss and have imbibed it in their lives, and you will attain that bliss. Go to those established in Brahman, and you will receive this knowledge.
"In the Gita, Bhagwan Krishna has said:
'Brahmabhutah prasannatma, na shochati na kankshati, (One who has become brahmarup is ever joyful; he neither grieves nor desires.)
Samah sarveshu bhuteshu, madbhaktim labhate param.' (Equal towards all beings, he attains supreme devotion to me.)

"What is such a sant like? He is in the brahmic state, he constantly remembers God, he helps others, he never causes anyone pain or trouble. From such a brahmarup person you will receive knowledge. What is the test of one who has become brahmarup? He has only joy, joy and joy. Whether he sits, stands or talks, he is joyful. He has no grief, and he never says anything that causes others grief. He has no kind of grief like 'this happened to me, that happened, I got this or did not get that'. If he gets something, fine, and if he does not, that is fine too. He has no desires of any kind either. He has constant compassion for every person and every living being. If someone beats him, strikes him, insults him or scorns him, he never wishes 'may harm come to him, may something bad happen to him'. Such a sant wishes for the good of all, wishes for the liberation of all. It is only through such persons that we attain happiness and peace in this world.

"In our India there have been wonderful sants and great souls. Bhagwan Swaminarayan also came to this earth. He made 500 such sadhus. He too gave this knowledge to everyone. Shastriji Maharaj was also a wonderful person. Whenever you saw Yogiji Maharaj, he was smiling. Whether someone honoured him or insulted him, he smiled, with only one feeling: 'Do good to him, may he be well.' He always said, 'May God bless everyone.' If someone had written against him, he would say, 'Bring it, let us read it. It is very well written. If we are making mistakes in this, they will be corrected.' Such was his knowledge, he was so carefree. Through him we receive this knowledge today. The values of our Indian culture, the Upanishads, the Ramayan, the Mahabharat, the Gita, and the Vachanamrut given by Bhagwan Swaminarayan, all these scriptures should be read, and so we should hold ghar sabha (family assembly). In the past our elders would gather at night and explain the stories of the Ramayan and Mahabharat to the children, and so the children received good values. That is why Jogi Maharaj said, 'Hold ghar sabha.' If the whole family sits together, holds ghar sabha and talks about the Ramayan and Mahabharat, the children will grow up with good values. There will be peace in the home, in society and in the country. Such were his very great thoughts. Yogiji Maharaj was such a sant, and our prayer is that through him all of you find great happiness and peace."

Now the first presentation of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show was about to take place. The Chief Minister and all the dignitaries came down from the stage and took their seats among the audience in the pavilion. Swamishri and the sadhus took leave of everyone and returned to their residence.

Within a few moments the water show began. For 45 minutes straight, everyone felt as if they had travelled to another world. Everyone's mind, intellect, heart and soul seemed to be filled with sat, chit and anand (being, consciousness and bliss). All the dignitaries were saying with one voice, "Unique... wonderful... unimaginable... indescribable... Countless salutations to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the creator of such a wonderful show... Only he can do such work of giving a spiritual message..."

After parting, all the dignitaries kept reliving the experience of "sat chit anand". Even during the meal, everyone kept talking only about today's ceremony and the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show. Some remained soaked all night in the spell of this ceremony held in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and of the water show.

Within moments of the show ending, its waves spread through television across India and the world. The next morning, almost all the newspapers in many cities of India hailed the water show, and TV channels sang its praises all day long. Acclaim spread everywhere.

While on one side everyone was greatly impressed by the whole presentation of the water show, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was thinking about something else entirely. When the whole programme ended, it was about half an hour late. Swamishri, who is meticulous in every task, had noticed this. That is why, after the inauguration of the show, sitting in the car, Swamishri said, "It was half an hour later than what was decided. When such guests are coming, this should not happen."
It is Swamishri's perfection that brings perfection to every task of the whole Sanstha.

ds.t: The greatest work for world peace
w: Shri Vijay Karad, founder of the famous MIT technology institute in Maharashtra and UNESCO Chair holder in Human Rights, Democracy, Peace and Tolerance, came today especially for Swamishri's darshan and blessings. During the meeting he said, "I am from the Warkari Sampraday. The Warkari tradition has gone on for 100 years and works for world peace, but the greatest work for world peace is yours alone. For the first time you have raised India to such heights and established spiritual knowledge. India is a land of knowledge. Such great work has been done through the Swaminarayan Sampraday that everyone praises it."

ds.t: Opening of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show
w: Today, honouring the invitation, dignitaries from Gujarat and India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham to enjoy the opening ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show, unique in the world and the first in India.

To welcome the dignitaries there was an unbroken line of volunteers from the entrance of Akshardham to the water show pavilion. Right in front of the pavilion, in the middle, touching the huge pool, a small and very beautiful stage had been decorated. Swamishri's seat, covered in flowers, looked simple yet very beautiful.

At exactly 6:30, His Holiness Swamishri and the dignitaries to be seated on the stage entered. Before that the dignitaries in the audience had taken their places. Among the many well known guests in the audience were the Speaker of the Gujarat Assembly Shri Ashokbhai Bhatt, Finance Minister Shri Vajubhai Vala, Minister Shri Nitinbhai Patel, Minister Shri Saurabhbhai Patel and BJP vice president Shri Purushottambhai Rupala. The famous scientist and father of the Indian supercomputer Dr. Vijay Bhatkar and the Ujjain scientist Ghanshyam Pande were also in the audience. Besides these, many IAS and IPS officers, chairmen and heads of various corporations, international industrialists, owners and editors of newspapers, writers, university vice chancellors, nationally known doctors, chartered accountants and advocates, media representatives and leading satsangis, about 1800 dignitaries in all, were present.

On the stage with Swamishri were Kothari Bhaktipriya Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami. On the other side were the chief guest of today's ceremony, Gujarat Chief Minister Shri Narendrabhai Modi, India's famous nuclear scientist and member of the Government of India's technical council Dr. R. Chidambaram, and the creative director of this water show, Shri Yves Pepin.
The atmosphere was divine and unforgettable. Everyone's body and mind felt a different kind of vibration.

At exactly 6:30 in the evening this auspicious programme began with Vedic chanting by children of the BAPS Bal Mandal. Singing the holy mantras in which, thousands of years ago, great rishis in the Upanishads and the Katha Upanishad sang of the supreme reality and explained the greatness of Brahman and Parabrahman, the children gave the atmosphere a Vedic touch.

Then the water show's director, Shri Yves Pepin, said in his address, "First of all, I wanted to be part of this project, because it is completely different from all the shows I have done in various countries of the world. I have done many shows, but they were all made only to entertain people. This show has a message. This message of Indian culture and deep spirituality is taken from the Upanishads. It is a message for every person with spirituality. That is why I wanted to be part of this project. I must say that all the BAPS volunteers and sadhus who worked with me, including Pramukh Swami Maharaj, worked with me like a family. I have had the joy of working with a true family. These family feelings made me feel very good. To share in these values, I gave my time to this project with passion. For me and the team I worked with, this show is far more special than any other work. It is one way of giving a spiritual message, and that way leads everyone towards Akshardham..."

ds.t: Dr. Chidambaram at the water show
w: Today, honouring the invitation, dignitaries from Gujarat and India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham to enjoy the opening ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show, unique in the world and the first in India.

India's eminent nuclear scientist and former chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission, Dr. R. Chidambaram, said, "By inviting me to the opening of this laser water show, Pramukh Swami Maharaj has honoured me. I have been meeting Pramukh Swami Maharaj for the past 15 years, and at every meeting I experience some new uplift, a rising upward. This morning too I had the good fortune of spending an hour with him. I visited Akshardham many years ago and was present at the opening of Delhi Akshardham. I have come here after a long time. In Delhi you have not only created a spiritual atmosphere, you also have great scientists: the famous scientists of ancient India, Bhaskaracharya, Aryabhata and Sushruta, and modern scientists C. V. Raman, J. C. Bose and others. In the wonderful boat ride exhibition at Swaminarayan Akshardham in Delhi, our ancient science can be seen.

The laser water show created here is a symbol of a unique union of technology and spirituality. Science can never accept what is not manifest; science can never give its answer. These are subtle and deep ideas. They are not so easy to understand. I am confident that in the laser show we are about to see, everyone will find its meaning."

ds.t: The Chief Minister at the water show
w: Today, honouring the invitation, dignitaries from Gujarat and India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham to enjoy the opening ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show, unique in the world and the first in India.

Chief Minister Shri Narendrabhai Modi paid a wonderful tribute to Pramukh Swami Maharaj's divine personality and work. Addressing the dignitaries he said, "Today, in the world, in Gujarat, in Gandhinagar and at Akshardham, the first water show coloured with spirituality, a happy union of spirituality and science, is beginning. I stayed in constant touch with this project, and seeing the enthusiasm and joy with which all the sadhus were engaged in building it, and the delight in turning imagination into reality that overflowed in their words, I felt that something wonderful was being created here that has the power to connect the people who come to Akshardham with India's culture of thousands of years.

I often feel that all the management institutes of the world should make a case study of the work done by Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj. They will find in it the highest principles of management and a glimpse of Indianness. If you want to learn how a person's skills can be used in the best way, how resources can be mobilised as fast as possible, and how resources and human skill can be combined within a fixed time frame, you should study deeply the work completed under Pramukh Swami Maharaj's leadership. His work gives us a great opportunity to understand the management principles of Indian life. It is a joy that in India sadhus are working with the most modern management skills, and this has the power to change the world's view of India.

Information technology has compelled the world to look at India differently. I am confident that the work being done by Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj, and the form in which it is being done, will compel the world to see, think about and accept our great tradition in a new way.

Experience has proved that the traditions our rishis and munis established and developed, the inspiration they gave for living and the teachings on conduct and thought, have passed the test of science. There is nothing in our philosophy of life that has not been weighed on the scales of science.

What a wonderful meeting of East and West is here! An artist of the West joins the heritage of the East with science and presents it before us. And only Pramukh Swami can do such work. When Shri Yves Pepin first came here, the problem must have begun with pronouncing the name Nachiketa. Even so, to absorb the character of Nachiketa, then give it creative form and join it with technology, I believe all this is the result of wonderful dedication. And our new generation will benefit from it. Through entertainment and science, wonderful teaching will happen here naturally and playfully. Coming to Akshardham, a person's faith will become firmer. Seeing the Akshardham exhibition, a person can experience the vast sky of knowledge.
Whoever comes here will receive the strength and inspiration to live in a new way, and for choosing the character of Nachiketa I bow to Pramukh Swami Maharaj from my heart."

ds.t: Swamishri's blessings at the water show
w: Today, honouring the invitation, dignitaries from Gujarat and India gathered at Swaminarayan Akshardham to enjoy the opening ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show, unique in the world and the first in India.

Finally, everyone was very eager to hear the blessings of Swamishri, the inspirer of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show, through whose constant warmth and inspiration it was created. In a simple and calm style, blessing everyone, Swamishri said:

"Yves Pepin's name is so meaningful: 'pi' and 'pa'. You drink (pi), and give others to drink (pa). He has shown the story of Nachiketa very beautifully in the water show. Drink such spiritual things and give them to others to drink. That is how meaningful the name is.

The story of Nachiketa comes in the Katha Upanishad. His father, the rishi Uddalak, performed a great yagna and gave thousands of cows to Brahmins in charity. We should give in charity only what is dear to us and good, but the cows Uddalak gave had stopped giving milk and were nearly dead. Nachiketa felt that it was not right for his father to give such charity. If you give, give something good. Nachiketa questioned his father, his father became angry and in his rage said, 'Go, I have given you to Yamaraja.' Nachiketa was cultured and obedient. Today's age is such that people leave their fathers somewhere in the forest, but Nachiketa went to the court of Yamaraja. Yama was pleased by his firmness. Nachiketa asked for boons. How cultured the son is! His father sends him to Yamaraja, yet he asks for a boon for his father's peace. Such incidents show what our Indian values are. Today there are problems in every home, but if we hear and learn such spiritual things, there will be peace in the family, society and nation. There are many such things in the Upanishads, but we have no time to read them; yet those who have read and reflected on them have walked that path and become happy.

When Nachiketa asks for the boon of understanding the secret of death, Yamaraja speaks of giving him the pleasures of the heavens, but Nachiketa refuses and asks for spiritual knowledge, for the liberation of the soul. He asked for peace and happiness and the good of others. Then Yama spoke of 'Uttishthata jagrata prapya varan nibodhata...' (Arise, awake, and learn by approaching the great). Go to the refuge of great souls who enjoy such spiritual happiness and have lived it, and you will receive that happiness. Go to those established in Brahman, and you will receive this knowledge.
In the Gita Lord Krishna has said:
'Brahmabhutah prasannatma, na shochati na kankshati;
samah sarveshu bhuteshu, madbhaktim labhate param.' (One who has become brahmarup, serene in spirit, neither grieves nor desires; equal towards all beings, he attains supreme devotion to Me.)

What is such a sant like? He is in the state of Brahman, constantly remembering God, doing good to others, never causing anyone pain or harm; from such a Brahmaswarup Purush you will receive knowledge. What is the test of one who has become Brahmaswarup? He has only joy, joy, joy. Sitting, rising, speaking, he is serene. He has no grief, and nothing he says causes grief to others. He has no grief that this happened or that happened, that he got this or did not get that. If he gets it, fine, and if not, fine. He has no desires of any kind either. He has constant compassion for every person and every living being. If someone beats him, strikes him, insults him or scorns him, he does not wish them harm. Such a sant wishes the good of all and the liberation of all. Only through such great souls do we find happiness and peace in this world.

Wonderful sadhus and great souls have lived in our India. Swaminarayan Bhagwan too came to this earth. He made five hundred such sadhus. He too gave this knowledge to everyone. Shastriji Maharaj too was a wonderful soul. As for Yogiji Maharaj, whenever you saw him he would be smiling. Whether someone honoured him or insulted him, he would smile, with only the feeling 'do good to him, do well by him'. He always said, 'O God, do good to all.' If someone had written against him, he would say, 'Bring it, let us read it. It is very well written. If we are making mistakes, they will be corrected.' Such was his knowledge; he was so carefree. Through him we receive this knowledge today. The values of our Indian culture, the Upanishads, Ramayana, Mahabharata, Gita, and the Vachanamrut given by Swaminarayan Bhagwan, all these scriptures should be read, so hold ghar sabha. In earlier times our elders would gather at night and explain stories of the Ramayana and Mahabharata to the children, and so they received good values. That is why Jogi Maharaj said, 'Hold ghar sabha.' If the whole family sits together, holds ghar sabha and talks about the Ramayana and Mahabharata, the children become cultured. He had very great thoughts, that there should be peace in the home, society and nation. Yogiji Maharaj was such a sant, so my prayer is that through him all of you receive great happiness and peace."

Now the first presentation of the Sat-Chit-Anand water show was to take place. The Chief Minister and all the dignitaries came down from the stage and took their seats in the pavilion audience. Swamishri and the sadhus took leave of everyone and went to their residence.

In a few moments the water show began. For 45 minutes everyone felt as if they had travelled through a different world. Everyone's mind, intellect, heart and soul seemed to have become filled with Sat-Chit-Anand. All the dignitaries said with one voice, "Unique..., wonderful..., unimaginable..., beyond words... Countless salutations to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, creator of such a wonderful show... Only he can do such work of giving a spiritual message..."

After parting, all the dignitaries kept reliving the experience of 'Sat Chit Anand'. Even during the meal, talk of today's ceremony and the water show kept echoing. Some stayed soaked all night in the spell of this ceremony held in Pramukh Swami Maharaj's presence and of the water show.

Within moments of the show ending, its ripples spread through television across India and the world. The next morning almost all newspapers in many cities of India hailed the water show, and TV channels sang its praises all day. There was acclaim everywhere.

While everyone was deeply impressed by the whole water show presentation, Swamishri was thinking of something else. When the whole programme ended, it was about half an hour late. Swamishri, who is meticulous in every task, had noticed this. So after the show's opening, sitting in the car, Swamishri said, "It was half an hour later than planned. When such guests are coming, this should not happen."
Swamishri's perfection is what brings perfection to every task of the whole organisation.

Today after the puja the sadhus gathered around Mahant Swami Maharaj. Every day when Swamishri reads the Shikshapatri (Bhagwan Swaminarayan's scripture of moral and spiritual codes), he first reads something on the opening page. Referring to this, an attendant asked: "What do you read on the first page every day?"
Swamishri said: "It has Bapa's signature!"

In the Shikshapatri that Swamishri reads, Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj has written a blessing and signed it. Swamishri begins his reading of the Shikshapatri with it every day. Then Swamishri said: "(In it, Bapa's) murti (divine form) rises up vividly before me." As he said this, Swamishri spoke with such feeling, as if the form of Guruhari were rising before him even then!

Returning from the puja in the car, Amrutswarupdas Swami asked Mahant Swami Maharaj: "After your puja you fold your hands and say 'Jai Swaminarayan' to everyone sitting in the assembly. Then a few moments later, as you return to your residence after the puja, you again fold your hands and say 'Jai Swaminarayan' with the same feeling and the same calm?"
"I never feel satisfied," Swamishri said suddenly, interrupting him.
How many people in the world never tire of folding their hands to others?

Shrutipriyadas Swami received a phone call from a devotee. A son had been born to his granddaughter, and the child needed a name. Shrutipriyadas Swami was reading out a list of names. Mahant Swami Maharaj said one name that was not on the list: "Divyaraj." He said nothing more.

When they spoke with the devotee on the phone, they learned that Swamishri had already named the child "Divyaraj" over the phone, because he had received the news earlier through someone else. Swamishri remembered it, and that is why he gave the very same name again!

st.t: United States Congress members experience Indian culture and heritage at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi
w: US Congress members visit Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi U.S. House of Representatives Thomas Richard Suozzi (New York – District 3) at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi U.S. House of Representatives Brenda Lulenar Lawrence (Michigan - District 14) at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi U.S. House of Representatives Andrew Ferguson IV (Georgia - District 3) at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi U.S. House of Representatives Pete Olson (Texas - District 22) at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi U.S. House of Representatives Thomas Richard Suozzi performing abhishek for world peace and harmony U.S. House of Representatives Brenda Lulenar Lawrence performing abhishek for world peace and harmony U.S. House of Representatives Andrew Ferguson IV and Pete Olson performing abhishek for world peace and harmony US Congress members offer sentiments for world peace, progress and prosperity at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi

Four members of Congress from the United States House of Representatives – Thomas Richard Suozzi, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New York’s 3rd district; Brenda Lawrence, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Michigan’s 14th district, Andrew Ferguson IV, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Georgia’s 3rd district and Pete Olson, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Texas’s 22nd district – specially visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi to experience Indian culture and heritage.

After a warm, traditional welcome, the four members offered their respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and admired its art and architecture. They viewed the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) and then performed abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni to pray for world peace and harmony. Thereafter, they experienced the ‘Sanskruti Vihar’ boat ride exhibition and the evening ‘Sahaj Anand’ water show.
Sharing their sentiments at Swaminarayan Akshardham, the U.S. Congress members wrote:

“We enjoyed the monumental human effort to manifest the divinity in us all. It is magnificent!! Thank you for the wonderful tour of the temple, The boat ride through Indian history, and the amazing water show! It was a memorable experience.” Thomas Richard Suozzi, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New York’s 3rd district
“Jai Swaminarayan. My visit was a true life event.” Brenda Lulenar Lawrence, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Michigan’s 14th district
“Jay Swaminarayan! I enjoyed my visit and the hospitality. Thank you.” Andrew Ferguson IV, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Georgia’s 3rd district

“Dear Mahant Swami + BAPS Friends: It was a pleasure to greet you at the BAPS temple in Stafford, Texas. This temple is magnificent.” Pete Olson, Member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Texas’s 22nd district
